notes.title: Update Notes for September 28
notes.content: This is a maintenance release to keep everything smooth and up to date.

notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 2
notes.content:
This patch adds some additional scripting entities that have been requested. You can use these entities to script your own scenes (levels) when players enter their radius:
[list]
[*] Load other scenes
[*] Set difficulty
[*] Warp players to another location
[*] Set game session options: Weapon Damage, Ship Movement Speed, AI Easy Mode, Disable FoW
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] It is now better highlighted that the easy mode is good for getting to know the game
[*] Smaller balancing improvements, especially for easy mode
[*] Some fixes for missions
[*] Display some details about a savegame after it has been loaded
[*] Translations improved
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes For Nov 29
notes.content:
The release of the game is going very well so far! No major issues have been reported yet. Nevertheless, I would like to release this small patch with some improvements to give you the best experience.
[list]
[*] Improvements to the tutorial to make some things easier to understand
[*] Improved translations
[*] Smaller adjustments to the balancing
[*] Tips for general improvements to the ship are now displayed in the hangar of the Last Outpost
[*] Process All Raw Materials now also processes asteroids
[*] Fixed ALT + ENTER hotkey
[/list]

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
This patch contains some smaller fixes for day 1:

[list]
[*] Introduced borderless window mode and made it default on Windows platform. This fixes rare rendering issues (black screen)
[*] Research 37 quest fixes
[*] Added rifts to some battles side quests to avoid backtracking
[*] Fixed exception in case of inconsistencies when Steam could not fully execute cloud sync
[/list]
